frank: Leaving notes from today's all-hands Q&A on security + compliance. Summarizing and collecting follow-ups here.

aya: Quick update on SOC2/ISO: Type I complete. Type II audit window targeted for May-June; report by Q3. ISO 27001 kickoff this quarter; timeline will be posted.

sara: Will SOC2 Type II include Dedicated hardware and Private deployments?

aya: Dedicated is in scope for Type II. Private deployments are scoped differently: if the control plane is Redwood-hosted we'll include it; if customer hosts everything (on-prem air-gapped) it's typically out of scope. We'll publish a scope matrix.

eli: KMS/BYOK status: AWS KMS and GCP KMS integrations live. Azure Key Vault is in preview. We do envelope encryption and never store plaintext CMKs. For HSM/CloudHSM we have a pilot; reach out if you need exposure.

tom: Does Redwood support key rotation initiated by Redwood or must the customer rotate keys?

eli: Customers are expected to manage CMK rotation in their KMS. We support key aliasing so rotations are transparent. Redwood-initiated rotation is possible but requires a legal/operational agreement.

maria: Audit logs: formats, retention, streaming?

eli: Exports available as ndjson; gzipped weekly bundles for long-term. Default retention 90 days, enterprise add-on up to 7 years. Streaming targets: S3, Kafka, webhook to Splunk/Datadog. PII redaction: configurable server-side redaction rules applied pre-export. Example minimal export config: ```json
{"destination":"s3://org-redwood-logs/","format":"ndjson","redact":["user.email"]}
```

frank: Who signs off on enterprise SLA clauses around incidents and credits?

maria: Legal + Sales handle enterprise contract language. SLA credits and indemnities negotiated case-by-case. For security incidents we follow IR playbook and provide post-incident reports.

aya: Action items: (1) I'll publish SOC2/ISO dates + scope matrix; (2) Eli will publish BYOK runbook and HSM pilot notes; (3) EngInfra to add VPC/control-plane topology + Private install checklist; (4) Ops to publish audit-log export walkthrough. Please reply if you want to be added to drafts or pilots.

frank: Add me to the HSM pilot and BYOK doc review.

eli: Done, adding you now.

elena: Thanks all. We'll keep this thread as the place for links and follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
